# Downloadable Bedrock packs

| File | What |
|------|------|
| **[Vultrom-0.1.8.mcaddon](./Vultrom-0.1.8.mcaddon)** | Both packs — easiest install |
| [Vultrom_BP-0.1.8.mcpack](./Vultrom_BP-0.1.8.mcpack) | Behavior pack only |
| [Vultrom_RP-0.1.8.mcpack](./Vultrom_RP-0.1.8.mcpack) | Resource pack only |

**Current:** v0.1.8 (packs **1.0.8**, Bedrock **1.21.50+**). Rebuild with `tools/build-dist.sh`.

**Install:** download → double-click to import into Minecraft Bedrock → create/edit world → enable **both** packs → play. **No experiments required.**

**Updating from an older Vultrom:** remove the old packs first — see [Upgrading](../README.md#upgrading-from-an-older-vultrom).

**Find ore:** `/function vultrom/find_sapphire`, `/function vultrom/find_ruby`.
